title: 2017 Ballroom Year
about: Twenty-two days during the Ballroom Year that became a story of performance, first love, change, and memories that lasted far beyond the fair.
description: TThis track brings together the full story of my 2017 Ballroom Year. I began the year performing beside Lanny, surrounded by the ballroom set, grand staircases, balcony, and yellow costume. Over twenty-two days, walks through the fair became hand-holding, hidden moments became a relationship, and the garden behind the Agriculture Building became the place where I finally gave that relationship a name. The story eventually shifted, ending quietly with only days left before the fair closed. The music was chosen to reflect the ballroom theme of that year, giving the song the elegant, sweeping feel of a ballroom dance and carrying that atmosphere through the story. Years later, hearing 'Shadows of Night' brought the entire summer rushing back: the ballroom, the yellow vest, the little jokes, the relationship, and the realization that a few weeks can leave memories that last a lifetime.
lyrics: Third year standing on the balcony,
Another show about to be made.
The ballroom waited down below me,
I thought I knew what I came there for...
Can begin in just one month.
A song... a hand... a summer...
Before you know it changed you.
You always found the group I walked with,
Like the fair was pulling you my way.
Before I knew what was happening,
You didn't simply hold my hand,
You laced your fingers into mine.
I stood there awkward, far too quiet...
You made the first move all along.
A song... a hand... a summer...
Before you know it changed you.
The afternoon I asked for you.
A kiss beneath the summer evening,
Your head resting across my knees.
I was trying not to get caught.
You were trying to hold the moment.
Neither one of us was wrong...
We just weren't standing in the same place anymore.
Four days left and something changed,
Though nothing really seemed to start.
I was back on the balcony.
In a song I didn't hear.
In the coffee you weren't supposed to drink.
In every memory that taught me
Love can happen faster than you think.
